description: Train from scratch an observation-conditioned multiscale correction network across three differentiable blind physical inverse steps, independent of DURA.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU6, source-only training, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Paired clean and impaired source IQ, first approved impaired view from epochs 21,22,23,11,...; each unrolled update sees observation gradient and frozen blind model.
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX source labels or U_s truth; only clean source IQ and frozen F soft outputs
data.validation_ref: RX4/6 source validation and RX8 source holdout excluded from training; later fixed restoration validation
data.leo_config_ref: Approved simulated impaired source IQ; fixed first non-clean view and no target adaptation

permissions.query_use: Approved source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated IQ and frozen F only; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or target test.
permissions.claim_scope: Prior training only, not a full restoration result or blind ground performance.

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh zero-output observation-conditioned network; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, independent blind action and source Gaussian prior; no DURA.
sources: Independent blind action checkpoint 94693a342bb2daa684c0f21415d7b949f9fb2107 and source Gaussian prior trained without DURA.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same 8192 source fit IDs and approved impaired view assignment as structured prior; F and blind action frozen, no DURA.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 8192 randomly sampled source fit IDs disjoint from original prior IDs and source validation/holdout, 8 fixed epochs, final checkpoint.

execution.launch_owner: Codex source direct mixture pilot owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU6 after idle check; real source smoke with 32 L_s and 32 U_s; TF32 off

dimensions: fixed source fit only; no TX label or validation scoring
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: End-to-end three observation-gradient and bounded learned correction steps; IQ, frozen F feature cosine and soft-distribution losses; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or target.

rows.purpose: Learn source paired correction using observations at every update, not a separately trained denoiser
rows.seed_notes: Fresh model seed 2026127054, fit seed 2026125055, training order seed 2026127055.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 8192 paired source records, one fixed impaired view each, 8 epochs, batch 8

notes: DURA absent from source training and intended inference; fixed independent blind model supplies forward operator.
Learned correction conditions on current state, observation-gradient update, blind variance and step index; 3 unrolled steps, shared parameters.
Zero initialization reproduces exactly the three-step pure observation solver; bounded residual correction.
Source fit paired clean and impaired IQ only; frozen F teacher; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or target.
Before inspecting source or ground evaluation, preregister exact full-step gate .8 source and seven-view ground evaluations.
